svg.title: AWS Lambda Durability: resume an agent run from its last completed step
svg.desc: A Lambda handler decorated with durable_execution and durable_agent_handler runs an agent named support that has the AWSLambdaDurability capability. In the first invocation, each model request and tool call runs as a durable step, and Lambda records its result in the checkpoint log under a step name such as support__model.request; the invocation times out during the second model request. The resumed invocation runs the handler again from the top: the two completed steps return their recorded results without calling the model or the tool again, and only the unfinished model request runs, is recorded, and finishes the run.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
